off.

Invited by Win Variation, we decided to go 
to a nearby fireworks festival.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to take up your time when you're 
busy. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: R-Really? I see, that's such a relief...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we get going? We've still 
got time before the fireworks... wanna 
grab something to eat?

That her roommate was apparently at the 
camp lodge too, that there was a flyer 
recruiting Bon Odori participants back at 
the dorm, and that there was supposedly a 
stall with delicious candy apples.

And so, while chatting about silly little 
things and making our way through the 
stalls—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Thank you so much...!

presence.

text_block_list.text:

coming to the festival today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:

but... Mind coming along with me?

She seemed to have a destination in mind.

walked ahead.

text_block_list.text:
"...I honestly didn't think I'd make it 
this far in the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.text:

many people cheering me on like this.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm truly grateful, really.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:

just for me, and on top of that, before 
races you'd encourage me and pull me 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

As Win Variation looked up at the sky, the 
faint glow of the fireballs reflected 
against her profile.
(Whistleee... BANG!!)

text_block_list.text:

hidden gem.

was just happy Win Variation wanted to do 
something for me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Really? Th-Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:

here. I look forward to your continued 
guidance and support!

As she bows so deeply in gratitude, I 
reflexively bow my head in return.

text_block_list.text:
As I replied with that, something suddenly 
crossed my mind—

Have I really done enough to deserve this 
much kindness?

She's grateful to me, but... all I'm doing 
is the bare minimum: planning training 
menus and encouraging her when she's 
feeling down.

"...It was her father who eased her nerves 
for her debut race, and Verxina who gave 
her energy without even realizing it by 
being someone who understood her."
Above all else—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

I hadn't become someone she could confide 
in, and she hadn't talked to me about it 
since.

On the day the Twinkle Series began, I 
swore to myself that I would support her 
with everything I had as her Trainer, and 
yet...

"Perhaps I grew complacent with just 
supporting her training, taking her 
silence for granted."
